## 1.0 Cross Validation

```{r}
library(tidyverse); library(lubridate); library(yardstick); library(here)
source(here("models.R"))

d   <- prep(readRDS(here("data_processed", "analysis.rds")))
dev <- filter(d, year <= 2023)

score_models <- function(train, test) {
  clim <- train |> group_by(wk = week(date)) |> summarise(clim = mean(pm25_next))
  test |>
    mutate(wk = week(date)) |>
    left_join(clim, by = "wk") |>
    transmute(date, region, truth = high_next, pm25_next,
              B1 = pm25, B2 = clim,
              M1 = predict_lasso(fit_lasso(train, FALSE), test),
              M2 = predict_lasso(fit_lasso(train, TRUE),  test),
              M3 = predict_rf(fit_rf(train, FALSE), test),
              M4 = predict_rf(fit_rf(train, TRUE),  test))
}

cv_preds <- map_dfr(2020:2023, \(v)
  score_models(filter(dev, year < v), filter(dev, year == v)) |> mutate(fold = v))
saveRDS(cv_preds, here("data_processed", "cv_preds.rds"))
```

## 1.1 Metrics

```{r}
recall_at <- function(truth, score, rate = 0.05) {
  mean(score[truth == "high"] >= quantile(score, 1 - rate))
}

cv_long <- cv_preds |> pivot_longer(B1:M4, names_to = "model", values_to = "score")

cv_long |>
  group_by(model) |>      # pooled over folds; repeat with group_by(model, fold)
  summarise(roc_auc   = roc_auc_vec(truth, score),
            pr_auc    = pr_auc_vec(truth, score),
            recall_5  = recall_at(truth, score),
            n_high    = sum(truth == "high"))
```

## 1.3 Uncertainty Measurement

```{r}
boot_gain <- function(p, without, with, B = 1000) {
  p <- mutate(p, blk = floor_date(date, "week"))
  blk_info <- p |> group_by(blk) |> summarise(has_high = any(truth == "high"))
  hi <- blk_info$blk[blk_info$has_high]
  lo <- blk_info$blk[!blk_info$has_high]

  gains <- replicate(B, {
    s <- tibble(blk = c(sample(hi, length(hi), replace = TRUE),
                        sample(lo, length(lo), replace = TRUE))) |>
      left_join(p, by = "blk", relationship = "many-to-many")
    pr_auc_vec(s$truth, s[[with]]) - pr_auc_vec(s$truth, s[[without]])
  })

  n_na <- sum(is.na(gains))
  if (n_na > 0) warning(n_na, " of ", B, " draws returned NA")
  c(quantile(gains, c(0.025, 0.5, 0.975), na.rm = TRUE), n_valid = B - n_na)
}
```

```{r}
count(cv_preds, fold, truth)                 # high days per validation year
colSums(is.na(select(cv_preds, B1:M4)))      # any missing predictions?
```

## 1.4 Final test and Analysis

```{r}
# analysis/40_test.R — run ONCE, after 00_plan.md and tuning settings are committed
library(tidyverse); library(lubridate); library(yardstick); library(here)
set.seed(42)
source(here("models.R"))   # prep(), fit_*(), predict_*(), score_models(), recall_at(), boot_gain()

analysis  <- readRDS(here("data_processed", "analysis.rds"))
T_HIGH    <- readRDS(here("data_processed", "T_HIGH.rds"))
fire_vars <- str_subset(names(analysis), "^(n|frp)_")

d    <- prep(analysis)
dev  <- filter(d, year <= 2023)
test <- filter(d, year == 2024)

# Guard against accidental reruns
out_path <- here("data_processed", "test_preds.rds")
if (file.exists(out_path)) stop("Final test already run: ", out_path,
                                ". Delete it only if you are documenting a rerun.")

# 1. Fit on 2017-2023, predict 2024
test_preds <- score_models(dev, test)
saveRDS(test_preds, out_path)

# 2. Run log for the report
writeLines(c(paste("Final test run:", Sys.time()),
             paste("Git commit:", system("git rev-parse --short HEAD", intern = TRUE)),
             paste("T_HIGH:", T_HIGH),
             paste("Train rows:", nrow(dev), "| Test rows:", nrow(test)),
             paste("High days in 2024:", sum(test_preds$truth == "high"))),
           here("data_processed", "test_run_log.txt"))

# 3. Metrics (same as CV)
n_high <- sum(test_preds$truth == "high")
test_long <- test_preds |> pivot_longer(B1:M4, names_to = "model", values_to = "score")

test_metrics <- test_long |>
  group_by(model) |>
  summarise(
    roc_auc  = if (n_high > 0) roc_auc_vec(truth, score) else NA_real_,
    pr_auc   = if (n_high > 0) pr_auc_vec(truth, score)  else NA_real_,
    recall_5 = if (n_high > 0) recall_at(truth, score)   else NA_real_,
    brier    = if (first(model) %in% c("M1", "M2", "M3", "M4"))
                 brier_class_vec(truth, score) else NA_real_,
    n_high   = n_high,
    .groups  = "drop"
  )
saveRDS(test_metrics, here("data_processed", "test_metrics.rds"))
test_metrics

# 4. Fire-gain intervals (only meaningful with enough high days)
if (n_high >= 10) {
  test_gains <- list(lasso = boot_gain(test_preds, "M1", "M2"),
                     rf    = boot_gain(test_preds, "M3", "M4"))
  saveRDS(test_gains, here("data_processed", "test_gains.rds"))
  test_gains
} else {
  message("Only ", n_high, " high days in 2024: skip the PR-AUC bootstrap, ",
          "report Brier score and the daily-mean regression result instead.")
}

# 5. Per-region breakdown for Step 7d
test_long |>
  group_by(model, region) |>
  summarise(n_high = sum(truth == "high"),
            roc_auc = if (n_high > 0 && n_high < n()) roc_auc_vec(truth, score) else NA_real_,
            .groups = "drop") |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = model, values_from = roc_auc)
```

## 1.5 Continuous Outcome Test

```{r}
fit_reg <- function(d, use_fire, kind = c("lasso", "rf")) {
  kind <- match.arg(kind)
  vars <- c(base_vars, if (use_fire) fire_vars)
  if (kind == "lasso") {
    X <- model.matrix(~ . - 1, d[, vars])
    list(kind = kind, use_fire = use_fire,
         m = glmnet::cv.glmnet(X, log(d$pm25_next), alpha = 1,
                               foldid = as.integer(factor(d$year))))
  } else {
    list(kind = kind, use_fire = use_fire,
         m = ranger::ranger(x = d[, vars], y = log(d$pm25_next),
                            num.trees = 500, seed = 42))
  }
}
predict_reg <- function(f, d) {
  vars <- c(base_vars, if (f$use_fire) fire_vars)
  p <- if (f$kind == "lasso")
    predict(f$m, model.matrix(~ . - 1, d[, vars]), s = "lambda.1se")[, 1]
  else predict(f$m, d[, vars])$predictions
  exp(p)
}

score_reg <- function(train, test) {
  clim <- train |> group_by(wk = week(date)) |> summarise(clim = mean(pm25_next))
  test |>
    mutate(wk = week(date)) |>
    left_join(clim, by = "wk") |>
    transmute(date, region, year, truth = pm25_next,
              B1 = pm25, B2 = coalesce(clim, mean(train$pm25_next)),
              M1 = predict_reg(fit_reg(train, FALSE, "lasso"), test),
              M2 = predict_reg(fit_reg(train, TRUE,  "lasso"), test),
              M3 = predict_reg(fit_reg(train, FALSE, "rf"),    test),
              M4 = predict_reg(fit_reg(train, TRUE,  "rf"),    test))
}

reg_cv <- map_dfr(2020:2023, \(v) score_reg(filter(dev, year < v), filter(dev, year == v)))
reg_test <- score_reg(dev, test)   # once, after the CV version is settled

mae_table <- function(p) p |>
  pivot_longer(B1:M4, names_to = "model", values_to = "pred") |>
  group_by(model) |>
  summarise(MAE = mean(abs(pred - truth)), .groups = "drop")
mae_table(reg_cv); mae_table(reg_test)
```

## 1.6 False Alarm check in the Test Set

```{r}
library(tidyverse); library(lubridate); library(here)

cv_preds   <- readRDS(here("data_processed", "cv_preds.rds"))
test_preds <- readRDS(here("data_processed", "test_preds.rds"))
models <- c("B1", "B2", "M1", "M2", "M3", "M4")

# 1. Alert cut-offs from CV only: each model's top 5% of risk scores in 2020-2023
cutoffs <- cv_preds |>
  pivot_longer(all_of(models), names_to = "model", values_to = "score") |>
  group_by(model) |>
  summarise(cutoff = quantile(score, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE),
            cv_recall = mean(score[truth == "high"] >= cutoff),   # what the cut-off catches in CV
            .groups = "drop")
saveRDS(cutoffs, here("data_processed", "alert_cutoffs.rds"))

# 2. Apply the fixed cut-offs to 2024
alerts <- test_preds |>
  pivot_longer(all_of(models), names_to = "model", values_to = "score") |>
  left_join(cutoffs, by = "model") |>
  mutate(alert = score >= cutoff)

# 3. Summary: false-alarm rate in a calm year (all alerts are false here)
false_alarms <- alerts |>
  group_by(model) |>
  summarise(region_days      = n(),
            alerts           = sum(alert),
            false_alarm_rate = mean(alert),            # compare with the 5% CV alert rate
            alert_dates      = n_distinct(date[alert]),# days with >=1 region alerting
            cv_recall        = first(cv_recall),
            .groups = "drop")
saveRDS(false_alarms, here("data_processed", "false_alarms_2024.rds"))
knitr::kable(false_alarms, digits = 3)

# 4. Longest run of consecutive alert days (a multi-day false haze warning is costly)
alerts |>
  arrange(model, region, date) |>
  group_by(model, region) |>
  mutate(run_id = cumsum(!alert)) |>
  filter(alert) |>
  count(model, region, run_id, name = "run_len") |>
  group_by(model) |>
  summarise(longest_run = max(run_len), .groups = "drop")

# 5. When did alerts happen, and how high was PM2.5 on those days?
alerts |>
  filter(alert, model %in% c("M2", "M4")) |>
  select(model, date, region, score, cutoff, truth_pm25 = pm25_next) |>
  arrange(model, desc(score)) |>
  print(n = 20)

# 6. Figure: 2024 risk for the fire models against their fixed cut-offs
alerts |>
  filter(model %in% c("M1", "M2", "M3", "M4")) |>
  ggplot(aes(date, score, colour = region)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_hline(aes(yintercept = cutoff), linetype = "dashed") +
  facet_wrap(~ model, ncol = 2) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Predicted probability of a high-PM2.5 day",
       title = "2024 risk scores vs alert cut-off fixed from 2020–2023 CV") +
  theme_minimal()
ggsave(here("figures", "fig_false_alarms_2024.png"), width = 9, height = 5, dpi = 300)
```

## 2.0 Calibration, Model Interpretation and Regression Residuals

```{r}
# analysis/50_diagnostics — Step 7a
library(tidyverse); library(lubridate); library(yardstick); library(here)
set.seed(42)
source(here("models.R"))

analysis  <- readRDS(here("data_processed", "analysis.rds"))
fire_vars <- str_subset(names(analysis), "^(n|frp)_")
d   <- prep(analysis)
dev <- filter(d, year <= 2023)
cv_preds <- readRDS(here("data_processed", "cv_preds.rds"))

monsoon <- function(m) case_when(m %in% c(12, 1, 2, 3) ~ "NE", m %in% 6:9 ~ "SW",
                                 TRUE ~ "inter")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Calibration (CV predictions, 2020-2023)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
cal_long <- cv_preds |>
  pivot_longer(c(M1, M2, M3, M4), names_to = "model", values_to = "p") |>
  mutate(y = as.integer(truth == "high"))

# Brier score per model
cal_long |>
  group_by(model) |>
  summarise(brier = mean((p - y)^2), n_high = sum(y), .groups = "drop")

# Binned reliability table. Fixed bins on a log-ish scale, because most
# predictions are near zero and high days are rare
cal_tab <- cal_long |>
  mutate(bin = cut(p, c(0, 0.01, 0.02, 0.05, 0.1, 0.2, 0.5, 1), include.lowest = TRUE)) |>
  group_by(model, bin) |>
  summarise(n = n(), mean_pred = mean(p), obs_rate = mean(y),
            se = sqrt(obs_rate * (1 - obs_rate) / n), .groups = "drop")
knitr::kable(cal_tab, digits = 3)

ggplot(cal_tab, aes(mean_pred, obs_rate)) +
  geom_abline(linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
  geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = pmax(obs_rate - 1.96 * se, 0),
                      ymax = pmin(obs_rate + 1.96 * se, 1), size = n),
                  fatten = 1.5, show.legend = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~ model) +
  labs(x = "Mean predicted probability (bin)", y = "Observed share of high days",
       title = "Calibration on 2020–2023 cross-validation predictions") +
  theme_minimal()
ggsave(here("figures", "fig_calibration.png"), width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Interpretation: refit M2 and M4 on all of 2017-2023
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
m2 <- fit_lasso(dev, use_fire = TRUE)
m4 <- fit_rf(dev, use_fire = TRUE)

# Lasso: non-zero coefficients (inputs are standardised internally,
# but coef() returns them on the original scale)
lasso_coef <- coef(m2$cv, s = "lambda.1se") |>
  as.matrix() |> as.data.frame() |>
  rownames_to_column("term") |>
  rename(estimate = 2) |>
  filter(estimate != 0, term != "(Intercept)") |>
  mutate(fire = str_detect(term, "^(n|frp)_")) |>
  arrange(desc(abs(estimate)))
knitr::kable(lasso_coef, digits = 4)
message(sum(lasso_coef$fire), " fire features kept by the lasso out of ", length(fire_vars))

# Random forest: permutation importance
rf_imp <- tibble(term = names(m4$variable.importance),
                 importance = m4$variable.importance) |>
  mutate(fire = str_detect(term, "^(n|frp)_")) |>
  slice_max(importance, n = 15)

ggplot(rf_imp, aes(importance, fct_reorder(term, importance), fill = fire)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "#d95f02", `FALSE` = "grey60"),
                    labels = c("Other", "Fire feature"), name = NULL) +
  labs(x = "Permutation importance", y = NULL,
       title = "M4 random forest: top 15 predictors (fit on 2017–2023)") +
  theme_minimal()
ggsave(here("figures", "fig_rf_importance.png"), width = 7, height = 5, dpi = 300)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Regression residuals (secondary outcome, CV 2020-2023)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
reg_long <- reg_cv |>
  pivot_longer(B1:M4, names_to = "model", values_to = "pred") |>
  mutate(resid = truth - pred,                 # µg/m³; positive = under-prediction
         monsoon = monsoon(month(date)))

# Residuals vs fitted (M2, M4)
reg_long |>
  filter(model %in% c("M2", "M4")) |>
  ggplot(aes(pred, resid)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.15, size = 0.6) +
  geom_smooth(se = FALSE, method = "loess", colour = "#d95f02") +
  facet_wrap(~ model) +
  labs(x = "Predicted next-day PM2.5 (µg/m³)", y = "Residual (µg/m³)") +
  theme_minimal()
ggsave(here("figures", "fig_resid_fitted.png"), width = 8, height = 3.5, dpi = 300)

# Residuals over time (look for runs of under-prediction = missed episodes)
reg_long |>
  filter(model %in% c("M1", "M2")) |>
  group_by(model, date) |>
  summarise(resid = mean(resid), .groups = "drop") |>
  ggplot(aes(date, resid, colour = model)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.7) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Mean residual across regions (µg/m³)") +
  theme_minimal()
ggsave(here("figures", "fig_resid_time.png"), width = 9, height = 3.5, dpi = 300)

# MAE by region and by monsoon season
mae_region <- reg_long |>
  group_by(model, region) |>
  summarise(MAE = mean(abs(resid)), .groups = "drop") |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = model, values_from = MAE)

mae_monsoon <- reg_long |>
  group_by(model, monsoon) |>
  summarise(MAE = mean(abs(resid)), n = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = model, values_from = MAE)

knitr::kable(mae_region, digits = 2)
knitr::kable(mae_monsoon, digits = 2)
```

## 2.1 Haze Onset Decisive Failure Case

```{r}
onsets <- cv_preds |>
  arrange(region, date) |>
  group_by(region) |>
  mutate(onset = truth == "high" & lag(truth) == "normal") |>
  ungroup()

onsets |>
  pivot_longer(B1:M4, names_to = "model", values_to = "score") |>
  group_by(model) |>
  mutate(alert = score >= quantile(score, 0.95)) |>
  filter(onset) |>
  summarise(n_onsets = n(), onset_recall = mean(alert))
```

## 2.2 Sensitivity Check

```{r}
# analysis/60_sensitivity
library(tidyverse); library(lubridate); library(yardstick); library(here)
set.seed(42)
source(here("models.R"))
source(here("rebuild_data.R"))

pm_long       <- readRDS(here("data_processed", "pm_long.rds"))
weather_daily <- readRDS(here("data_processed", "weather_daily.rds"))
T_HIGH        <- readRDS(here("data_processed", "T_HIGH.rds"))
T_ALT         <- if (T_HIGH == 37.5) 25 else 37.5
viirs_path    <- here("data_raw", "firms", "fire_archive_SV-C2_854993.csv")
modis_path    <- here("data_raw", "firms", "fire_archive_M-C61_854992.csv")      # adjust file names

pm_main   <- build_pm_daily(pm_long, 18)
fire_main <- build_fire_daily(viirs_path, "viirs")

cached <- function(name, expr) {
  path <- here("data_processed", "sens", paste0(name, ".rds"))
  dir.create(dirname(path), showWarnings = FALSE)
  if (file.exists(path)) return(readRDS(path))
  out <- expr; saveRDS(out, path); out
}

# Run CV for one variant; fire_vars is a global used by models.R
run_cv <- function(analysis, train_years = 2017:2023, val_years = 2020:2023) {
  fire_vars <<- str_subset(names(analysis), "^(n|frp)_")
  d <- prep(analysis) |> filter(year %in% train_years)
  cls <- map_dfr(val_years, \(v) score_models(filter(d, year < v), filter(d, year == v)))
  reg <- map_dfr(val_years, \(v) score_reg(filter(d, year < v), filter(d, year == v)))
  summarise_variant(cls, reg)
}

summarise_variant <- function(cls, reg) {
  n_high <- sum(cls$truth == "high")

  c_tab <- cls |>
    pivot_longer(M1:M4, names_to = "model", values_to = "score") |>
    group_by(model) |>
    summarise(
      pr_auc  = if (n_high > 0 && !all(is.na(score))) pr_auc_vec(truth, score)  else NA_real_,
      roc_auc = if (n_high > 0 && !all(is.na(score))) roc_auc_vec(truth, score) else NA_real_,
      .groups = "drop")

  r_tab <- reg |>
    pivot_longer(M1:M4, names_to = "model", values_to = "pred") |>
    group_by(model) |>
    summarise(MAE = mean(abs(pred - truth), na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

  left_join(c_tab, r_tab, by = "model") |>
    mutate(n_high = n_high, n_rows = nrow(cls))
}

variants <- list(
  main          = \() build_analysis(pm_main, weather_daily, fire_main, T_HIGH),
  threshold_alt = \() build_analysis(pm_main, weather_daily, fire_main, T_ALT),
  modis         = \() build_analysis(pm_main, weather_daily,
                                     build_fire_daily(modis_path, "modis"), T_HIGH),
  keep_low_conf = \() build_analysis(pm_main, weather_daily,
                                     build_fire_daily(viirs_path, "viirs", keep_low = TRUE), T_HIGH),
  single_total  = \() build_analysis(pm_main, weather_daily,
                                     build_fire_daily(viirs_path, "viirs", zones = FALSE), T_HIGH),
  min_hours_12  = \() build_analysis(build_pm_daily(pm_long, 12), weather_daily, fire_main, T_HIGH)
)

sens <- imap_dfr(variants, \(build, name)
  cached(name, run_cv(build())) |> mutate(variant = name))

# Haze-year stress test: train on 2017-2023 except 2019, test on 2019 (breaks time order)
haze_test <- cached("haze_2019", {
  a <- variants$main()
  fire_vars <<- str_subset(names(a), "^(n|frp)_")
  d <- prep(a)
  tr <- filter(d, year <= 2023, year != 2019); te <- filter(d, year == 2019)
  summarise_variant(score_models(tr, te), score_reg(tr, te))
})
sens <- bind_rows(sens, mutate(haze_test, variant = "haze_2019_stress"))

# Compact table: fire gain for each variant
sens_table <- sens |>
  select(variant, model, pr_auc, MAE, n_high) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = model, values_from = c(pr_auc, MAE)) |>
  mutate(gain_pr_lasso = pr_auc_M2 - pr_auc_M1,
         gain_pr_rf    = pr_auc_M4 - pr_auc_M3,
         gain_mae_lasso = MAE_M1 - MAE_M2,      # positive = fire features reduce error
         gain_mae_rf    = MAE_M3 - MAE_M4)
saveRDS(sens_table, here("data_processed", "sensitivity_table.rds"))
knitr::kable(select(sens_table, variant, n_high, starts_with("gain")), digits = 3)
```

## 2.3 Subgroup Measurement
```{r}
cv_preds <- readRDS(here("data_processed", "cv_preds.rds"))
monsoon <- function(m) case_when(m %in% c(12, 1, 2, 3) ~ "NE", m %in% 6:9 ~ "SW",
                                 TRUE ~ "inter")

subgroup_cls <- function(p, group_var) {
  p |>
    mutate(monsoon = monsoon(month(date))) |>
    pivot_longer(M1:M4, names_to = "model", values_to = "score") |>
    group_by({{ group_var }}, model) |>
    summarise(n_high  = sum(truth == "high"),
              n       = n(),
              pr_auc  = if (n_high > 0 && n_high < n) pr_auc_vec(truth, score) else NA_real_,
              roc_auc = if (n_high > 0 && n_high < n) roc_auc_vec(truth, score) else NA_real_,
              .groups = "drop") |>
    pivot_wider(names_from = model, values_from = c(pr_auc, roc_auc))
}

subgroup_reg <- function(p, group_var) {
  p |>
    mutate(monsoon = monsoon(month(date))) |>
    pivot_longer(B1:M4, names_to = "model", values_to = "pred") |>
    group_by({{ group_var }}, model) |>
    summarise(MAE = mean(abs(pred - truth)), n = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
    pivot_wider(names_from = model, values_from = MAE)
}

cls_region  <- subgroup_cls(cv_preds, region)
cls_monsoon <- subgroup_cls(cv_preds, monsoon)
reg_region  <- subgroup_reg(reg_cv, region)
reg_monsoon <- subgroup_reg(reg_cv, monsoon)

walk(list(cls_region, cls_monsoon, reg_region, reg_monsoon),
     \(t) print(knitr::kable(t, digits = 3)))

# 2024 test, regression only (no high days for classification)
reg_test_region <- subgroup_reg(reg_test, region)
knitr::kable(reg_test_region, digits = 2)

# Figure: MAE gain from fire features by region and season (CV)
bind_rows(
  reg_region  |> transmute(group = region,  type = "Region", lasso = M1 - M2, rf = M3 - M4),
  reg_monsoon |> transmute(group = monsoon, type = "Monsoon season", lasso = M1 - M2, rf = M3 - M4)
) |>
  pivot_longer(c(lasso, rf), names_to = "model", values_to = "gain") |>
  ggplot(aes(gain, group, fill = model)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0) +
  facet_wrap(~ type, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(x = "MAE reduction from fire features (µg/m³; positive = better)", y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal()
ggsave(here("figures", "fig_subgroup_gain.png"), width = 8, height = 4, dpi = 300)
```
